g.text: Walkthrough: 8 steps from git push to production
Yellow = CI in the APP REPO (gitops-apps) Green = CD in the GITOPS REPO (gitops-monorepo) + ArgoCD Red box = the real file. Read 1 -> 8 (snake).
TWO REPOS, EACH WITH ITS OWN WORKFLOWS
ci.yaml validate + e2e every config change
e2e: # kind cluster + the GitOps repo's chart
deploy-dev: # main only -> commit to the GitOps repo
run: npm ci && npm run lint && npm test
5) hand over { app, tag, digest, new_release }
DEPLOY DEV = COMMIT TO THE GITOPS REPO
# app CI, via deploy key: scripts/set-image.sh dev orders-api <tag> <digest>
CI: 0.2.0 not in registry -> tag the build
-> push branch promote/qa-* to the GitOps repo
plan: # qa tag + digest, verify in GHCR
# admission policy: kubectl edit is DENIED
ONE-TIME BY HAND: make up -> kind + ArgoCD + kubectl apply -f argocd/bootstrap/root-app.yaml
After that every change reaches the cluster through Git only. Details: docs/manual-steps.md | docs/automation-steps.md
